label: a2-commitment, mid-episode: GO after unrewarded trial / D2 at S2 after rewarded trial
explanation: Fires essentially only on trials where the agent chooses a2 (99.9% of mass; never on a1 trials, never at D1, never when the reward input is 1), and only on GO and D2 steps. Strongly restricted to the middle of the episode (ep_trial ~20-60, zero after trial 80 and before ~10), so it likely reflects slow hidden-state drift over the episode. At D2 it fires when a2 reached S2 (common) and the previous trial was rewarded (dev P 0.70 within mid-episode); at GO it fires more weakly predictably, enriched when the previous trial was unrewarded and the a2 logit is moderately (not extremely) confident. GO activations carry the largest magnitudes (58% of mass). The only FUTURE variable used is action at GO, which is the agent own upcoming choice (legitimate); at D2 action/state are observed. Dev: P 0.54, R 0.67, F1 0.59, mass recall 0.77; the simpler (phase != D1) & (action == 2) & mid-episode gets R 0.90 but P 0.30.
